arStrings.szText: {icon:bullet,1.2} Your {c_important}Earth{/c} Skills {c_important}Fossilize{/c} enemies, reducing their movement speed by {c_number}[Affix_Value_1*100|%|]{/c} and increasing the damage they take from your {c_important}Earth{/c} Skills by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"*100|x%|]{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds. Enemies become {c_important}Fossilized{/c} at {c_number}[Affix_Value_2]{/c} stacks, {c_important}Petrifying{/c} them for {c_number}3{/c} seconds. {c_important}Petrified{/c} enemies are Stunned and take {c_important}[100|%|]{/c} bonus Critical Strike Damage.
